schema: CREATE TABLE t2s_products (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(100), category VARCHAR(50), price NUMERIC(10, 2)); CREATE TABLE t2s_customers (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(100), region VARCHAR(50)); CREATE TABLE t2s_sales (id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER, amount NUMERIC(10, 2), sale_date DATE, customer_id INTEGER);

test_cases.question_th: สินค้าประเภท Electronics มีอะไรบ้าง
test_cases.question_en: What products are in the Electronics category?
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT id, name FROM t2s_products WHERE category = 'Electronics'

test_cases.question_th: รวมยอดขายทั้งหมด
test_cases.question_en: What is the total sales amount?
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM t2s_sales

test_cases.question_th: มีลูกค้ากี่คนในภาคเหนือ
test_cases.question_en: How many customers are in the North region?
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM t2s_customers WHERE region = 'ภาคเหนือ'

test_cases.question_th: ราคาเฉลี่ยของสินค้าเท่าไหร่
test_cases.question_en: What is the average price of products?
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM t2s_products

test_cases.question_th: ยอดขายสูงสุดคือเท่าไหร่
test_cases.question_en: What is the maximum sales amount?
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT MAX(amount) AS max_amount FROM t2s_sales

test_cases.question_th: ราคาสินค้าต่ำสุดเท่าไหร่
test_cases.question_en: What is the minimum product price?
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT MIN(price) AS min_price FROM t2s_products

test_cases.question_th: ยอดขายแยกตามประเภทสินค้า
test_cases.question_en: What is the sales amount by product category?
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales FROM t2s_sales s JOIN t2s_products p ON s.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category

test_cases.question_th: สินค้าราคาสูงสุด 5 อันดับ
test_cases.question_en: What are the top 5 most expensive products?
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM t2s_products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5

test_cases.question_th: ลูกค้าที่ซื้อในวันที่ 2024-02-01 มีใครบ้าง
test_cases.question_en: Who are the customers who bought on 2024-02-01?
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name FROM t2s_customers c JOIN t2s_sales s ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE s.sale_date = '2024-02-01'

test_cases.question_th: มีลูกค้ากี่คนที่ซื้อสินค้า (ไม่ซ้ำ)
test_cases.question_en: How many unique customers made purchases?
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS count FROM t2s_sales
